snippet.title: Amazing Slot Survivor | A.S.S Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Spin the slot machine. 
If luck is on your side, your power explodes. 
Level up fast, collect items, and build your loadout. 
Hunt down “Spawners” that endlessly create monsters, survive the bullet hell, and clear stages. 
Overwhelm enemies with insane growth driven by luck and choice.

#amazingslotsurvivor #trailer #indiegame
